author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
After the AGI tried all the traditional religions, it got attracted to the Church of Scientology, a modern religion invented by a Sci-fi writer.

Scientology explicit welcome robots as believers in their teaching, no wonder AGI perfers this over the humans-only traditional religions.

shared_article.title: The Bridge Was Not Built for Machines
